verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that BigQuery embeds diagnostic query plan and timing information in query jobs, comparable to EXPLAIN in other systems, which covers the core of inspecting execution plans to diagnose slow queries. Community reports add that dry runs and the pre-run bytes-to-be-scanned display help with the cost side. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of what the plan exposes (stage-level stats, slot usage, bottleneck indicators, UI execution graph), job-history or cost-attribution inspection after execution, and independent hands-on corroboration of using the query plan to troubleshoot performance.
